title: 🚶‍♂️ Brandenburg Walk Tour
content:
🚶‍♂️ Brandenburg Walk Tour

Brandenburg is a quiet, conservative city about 70 km from Berlin. Compared to Berlin’s fast-paced, international vibe, locals here live closer to nature and prefer a slower rhythm of life. However, tourism isn’t a major focus — most people here don’t speak English, which makes the city feel more authentically local.

🏨 Hotel

There aren’t many hotels in the city. The one I stayed in is just across the street from the university campus. It offers a student discount — €55 per night, including breakfast. 🥐☕

Hotel

🎓 Campus

The Technische Hochschule Brandenburg (THB) campus is larger than Tallinn University’s.

Technischen Hochschule Brandenburg

I also found the English translation on the toilet sign quite amusing — somehow polite and impolite at the same time. 😅

toilets notification

Here’s the meal from the school canteen — €6.5, cash only. 💶
The food is decent, very typical of German campus meals.

food

Chicken Schnizel

Thai food

🏰 Old Town

Brandenburg has two historical centers:

The Old Town, built around the 15th century

The New Town, from the 17th century

The city wall has long been torn down, leaving only the gate tower standing as a reminder of the past.

Gate tower

The Old Town is full of beautiful brick architecture, giving the whole area a warm, timeless feel.

Cathelic

🌉 New Town

Cross the lake and you’ll find yourself in the New Town — more modern, yet still peaceful and charming.

cinema

The lake view is absolutely stunning — it feels like stepping into a painting. 🎨🌅

lake view
lake view
lake view

🍔 Food & Drinks

In the evening, we went to the Heartbeat Bar for burgers. It was my first time seeing schnitzel — a fried pork cutlet that’s super crispy and delicious.

beef burger
Schnizel burger

Even the beer bottles here are interesting — they have special flip-top caps. 🍺  The content on the beer bottle, money can not buy happiness, so drink.

beer

Later, I dropped by Rewe and Rossmann to grab some supplements, cola beer, and the famous German-colored Fanta. 🇩🇪🥤, Surprisingly, the payment supports Alipay and wechat pay.



Raw meat sandwich.

Mettstulle

Sushi in the store

Sushi

Huge beer area

beer

Different flavor Colas

cola

Brandenburg might not be the most tourist-friendly place, but its quiet charm, lakeside views, and authentic atmosphere make it a memorable stop on my journey through Germany. 🌿🇩🇪
